title: Recompute instead of store
summary: What activation checkpointing trades, and when it is the right tool.

choices.text: Memory drops and the step gets faster, because fewer activations are written to HBM.
Activation memory drops to roughly one saved input per block, and each step costs about one extra forward pass of compute.
Only the optimizer state shrinks, so the batch of 4 still does not fit.
The result changes slightly, because recomputed activations differ from the stored ones in their rounding.
